title: 12. Long/Short Investing w/ George Livadas from Upslope Capital

reader_summary.headline: Hello and welcome to an episode of the Best Anchor Stocks Podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hello and welcome to an episode of the Best Anchor Stocks Podcast. In today's episode, I have a discussion with George Livedas, founder of Upslope Capital. George follows a long short strategy and he explains why during the episode.

thesis: George Livadas explains that his career began in investment banking and securitization before he fell in love with picking stocks during business school, leading him to transition to equity research and eventually start his own long/short fund. He notes that starting a new fund is easy, but the hard part is the long ramp-up period required to build a track record and survive, especially for those with non-traditional backgrounds.
